errors.evidence: The left y-axis label is 'Perplexity', not 'Perplexity (%)'. The values on this axis are not percentages.
The range of the left y-axis (Perplexity) is from 4.2 to 4.7. The value 100% belongs to the right y-axis.

errors.text_span: with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1%
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the left y-axis are spaced at intervals of 0.1 (e.g., 4.2, 4.3, 4.4), not 1%.

errors.text_span: A red line with circular markers, representing Perplexity
errors.evidence: The line representing 'Perplexity' is orange, not red. The red dashed line represents 'Full Cache PPL'.

errors.text_span: begins at a value of approximately 4.7% at 0% sequence ratio
errors.evidence: The orange 'Perplexity' line begins at a recent sequence ratio of approximately 10% (not 0%) with a perplexity value of approximately 4.59 (not 4.7%).

errors.text_span: decreases to approximately 4.3% at 100% sequence ratio
errors.evidence: The 'Perplexity' line ends at a value of approximately 4.38 at 100% sequence ratio, not 4.3. Also, the unit '%' is incorrect.

errors.text_span: decreases to approximately 4.3% at 100% sequence ratio
errors.evidence: The description of the 'Perplexity' line trend is oversimplified. It decreases to a minimum at 40%, then increases, and finally slightly decreases. Simply stating it 'decreases' is not accurate to the data shown.

errors.text_span: A dashed red line, representing Full Cache PPL, starts at a value of approximately 60% at 0% sequence ratio and gradually decreases to approximately 64% at 100% sequence ratio.
errors.evidence: This entire description is incorrect. The dashed red line is a constant horizontal line corresponding to the left y-axis at a Perplexity value of approximately 4.38. It does not start at 60%, is not read against the right y-axis, and does not change value.

errors.text_span: A blue line with circular markers, representing GPU Mem. Ratio, starts at a value of approximately 80% at 0% sequence ratio and decreases to approximately 48% at 100% sequence ratio.
errors.evidence: This description is completely wrong. The blue line (GPU Mem. Ratio) INCREASES from approximately 41% (at a ratio of ~10%) to 100% (at a ratio of 100%). The description states the opposite trend and uses incorrect starting and ending values.

errors.text_span: A dashed blue line, representing Full Cache GPU Mem., begins at a value of approximately 80% at 0% sequence ratio and decreases to approximately 50% at 100% sequence ratio.
errors.evidence: This is entirely fabricated. The dashed blue line is a constant horizontal line at 100% on the right y-axis ('GPU Mem. Ratio (%)'). It does not start at 80% or decrease to 50%.
While the x-axis labels span up to 100, the actual data points for the two main series start at approximately 10%, not 0%.
